question:
How do I run a dbt run-operation with arguments that have environment variables. For eg:

dbt run-operation my_macros --args '{"model":"abc", "colour":"$COLOUR_NAME"}'

It seems that $COLOUR_NAME is not getting the value of the variables as expected.
title: dbt run operation with args that has environment variable
answer:
Instead of passing it in command line, you can reference the environment variable as a default value directly in your macro.

{% macro my_macros(model, colour=env_var('COLOUR_NAME')) %}
...
{% endmacro %}

This gives you the option to either use the environment variable value or to override it in the command line with the --args option you have above.
